title: Great time in the water!
text: I had a great time with Andy and Costa Brava was beautiful. The original date I booked was rescheduled due to weather, and I really appreciate that they had the foresight to reach out early and offer us a different day. The water was a bit rough still but the team does all the difficult stuff like launching the kayaks and pulling you back in, which was nice. I appreciated the flexibility of our time in the water (you can hang out on the beach, snorkel, swim, and jump) and I had a lot of fun jumping  off the cliff! Highly recommend. title: Great day, wasnt the best...
text: Great day, wasnt the best weather and water conditions but Andy made it the best experience possible for all involved
author: natalie_c

title: Great weather and love everything about Barcelona
text: Two hour ride on a great AC clean bus. Everything was great. Kayaking snorkeling was one and a half hour long and it was perfect timing and perfect weather!
author: Myloan_D

title: Fantastic tour! Highly recommended
text: This was an excellent tour - highly recommended. Very professional and friendly operators. I would only suggest improving the food a little bit by adding my sauce and meat into the rolls. Otherwise we loved it thoroughly. Thank you so much.
author: MiguelCarlo_R

title: 5 stars all around!
text: Such a wonderful experience. Would definitely go again and recommend! Kayaking was great, snorkeling amazing and cliff jumping so much fun.  Our guide was equally amazing and offered to give tips on things to do and places to eat!
author: E6406XWsamantham

title: Great time!
text: Such a good experience! We were a hen group and had Andy as our guide. We wanted  to travel with everyone else but a separate for the activity and the company sorted it out no problem at all. The experience was amazing, scenery fantastic, loved the snorkelling stop and the cliff jump! Thanks so much for a great day.
author: Kate_L

title: The guides were all super...
text: The guides were all super friendly and were willing to be flexible with me - it was incredibly windy and I was hesitant, so they gave me an alternative to kayaking! I had the most amazing time snorkeling on the most beautiful beach which they directed me to instead! Great guides and great activities! Definitely worth it!
author: Halee_S

title: Fun day trip
text: Great bus. Tour guides were helpful. Gear was in good shape.  A fun day. Definitely bring water shoes.
author: Cruiser435232

title: Great day trip from Barcelona
text: Beautiful beaches in Costa Brava! Lovely day getting out in the water and snorkeling in beautiful location. Very well organized. It was a great break from the city tours! Staff was all great!
author: Zina_B

title: Worth it!
text: Loved it! Great activity to do with family.
